traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text:
Its innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13); no material components.
2/day each: disguise self, invisibility (self only)

traits.name: Reckless
traits.text: At the start of its turn it can take advantage on its melee weapon attacks this turn; attacks against it then have advantage until its next turn starts.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.text: With a running start: long jump up to 40 ft, high jump up to 20 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: It makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its fists.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Drone
traits.text: A creature other than a demon that starts its turn within 30 ft and can hear it makes a DC 12 Constitution save or falls unconscious for 10 minutes (ends if it takes damage or is splashed with holy water); a success or the end of it makes it immune for 24 hours.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: It climbs difficult surfaces, upside down on ceilings too, without a check.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) necrotic damage; the target's hit point maximum drops by the necrotic damage taken until it finishes a long rest (or greater restoration), and it dies if that brings it to 0.

actions.text: It turns into toxic mist with its gear, or back. As mist it is incapacitated, can't speak, flies 30 ft (hover), passes through any gap that isn't airtight, has advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves and is immune to nonmagical damage; it can stop in a creature's space, and that creature makes a DC 14 Constitution save each time it starts its turn there or is poisoned (and incapacitated) until its next turn starts.

definitions.name: Heammer Wisp
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Ephemeral
traits.text: The Wisp can't wear or carry anything. Its hit point maximum can't be increased, and it can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The Wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Variable Illumination
traits.text: The Wisp sheds bright light in a radius of 5 to 20 feet and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The Wisp can change the radius as a bonus action.

actions.name: Burn
actions.text: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (3d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Read the Heart
actions.text: The Wisp chooses one creature it can see within 120 feet and magically learns the creature's current emotional state. If the target fails a DC 10 Charisma saving throw, the Wisp also learns the creature's alignment. Eunoic creatures, fiends, and undead automatically fail this saving throw.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The Wisp and its light magically become invisible until it attacks, uses Give Life, or its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

bonusActions.name: Give Life (Recharge 6)
bonusActions.text: The Wisp targets one living creature it can see within 5 feet of itself that has 0 hit points. If the target isn't a construct or an undead, it regains 10 (3d6) hit points. The Wisp's current and maximum hit points are reduced by the same amount.
